name: agentboard
description: Zero-dependency local-first SQLite (WAL) + stdio MCP Kanban tracker built for autonomous AI agent swarms.

tools.name: board_list
tools.description: List tasks from AgentBoard SQLite database filtered by department or status.

tools.name: board_add
tools.description: Create a new task ticket on AgentBoard.

tools.name: board_move
tools.description: Move an existing task to a new Kanban status (enforces BOARD_ACTION human-approval lock).

tools.name: board_flag_board
tools.description: Flag a task as BOARD_ACTION for sole Board Member approval.
